confrontation.label: The Protector
confrontation.answer: They avoid violence when possible, but immediately step in when someone weaker is being threatened.

confrontation.label: The Reluctant Hero
confrontation.answer: They do not want trouble, but they cannot ignore suffering once they see it.

confrontation.label: The Talk-First Diplomat
confrontation.answer: They try to negotiate before fighting, believing most conflicts can be avoided if people are willing to listen.

confrontation.label: The Survivor
confrontation.answer: They avoid fair fights and only engage when cornered, outnumbered, or forced to protect themselves.

confrontation.label: The Justice-Driven Avenger
confrontation.answer: They are usually calm, but cruelty, corruption, or abuse of power makes them act immediately.

confrontation.label: The Glory-Seeker
confrontation.answer: They see conflict as a chance to prove themselves and may jump into danger before thinking it through.

confrontation.label: The Strategist
confrontation.answer: They dislike chaos and prefer to observe, plan, and win the fight before it really begins.

confrontation.label: The Trickster
confrontation.answer: They would rather confuse, distract, deceive, or embarrass an enemy than fight them directly.

confrontation.label: The Defender of Nature
confrontation.answer: They are slow to anger unless animals, forests, rivers, or sacred places are threatened.

confrontation.label: The Honorable Duelist
confrontation.answer: They believe conflict should have rules, and they prefer direct, honorable combat over ambush or cruelty.

confrontation.label: The Emotional Fighter
confrontation.answer: They try to stay calm, but when someone they love is hurt, emotion takes over and they become dangerous.

confrontation.label: The Coward Learning Courage
confrontation.answer: Their first instinct is fear, but they are slowly learning to stand their ground when it matters.

confrontation.label: The Professional
confrontation.answer: They treat conflict like a job: assess the threat, protect the objective, and finish efficiently.

confrontation.label: The Merciful Combatant
confrontation.answer: They will fight if necessary, but they prefer to disable, restrain, or redeem enemies rather than kill them.

confrontation.label: The Chaos Agent
confrontation.answer: They thrive in confusion and may start improvising wildly the moment things go bad.

confrontation.label: The Vengeful One
confrontation.answer: They can ignore insults and threats, but if someone reminds them of an old wound, they lose restraint quickly.

confrontation.label: The Bodyguard
confrontation.answer: They are always watching exits, threats, and who is standing too close to the people they care about.

confrontation.label: The Bully Hunter
confrontation.answer: They cannot stand people who use power to intimidate others, and they often escalate when they see it.

confrontation.label: The Pacifist Pushed Too Far
confrontation.answer: They hate violence and try every other option first, which makes it shocking when they finally fight.

confrontation.label: The Reckless Friend
confrontation.answer: They may not care much about their own safety, but they will throw themselves into danger for a friend without hesitation.

motivation.label: Avenge Their Family
motivation.answer: They want to find and punish the people responsible for destroying their family or home.

motivation.label: Protect Their Home
motivation.answer: They are adventuring because their village, city, forest, or homeland is threatened.

motivation.label: Stop the War
motivation.answer: They see the rising conflict between Elkenquay and Fastingbreak as dangerous and want to prevent disaster.

motivation.label: Get Rich
motivation.answer: They want enough wealth that no one can control, dismiss, or endanger them again.

motivation.label: Seek Fame
motivation.answer: They want their name remembered in songs, stories, histories, or tavern gossip.

motivation.label: Prove Themselves
motivation.answer: They are tired of being underestimated and want to prove they are capable of greatness.

motivation.label: Expose Corruption
motivation.answer: They believe powerful people are hiding the truth and want to reveal what is really happening.

motivation.label: Serve a God or Oath
motivation.answer: They believe they have been called to act on behalf of a god, spirit, oath, or sacred cause.

motivation.label: Understand Strange Magic
motivation.answer: They are drawn to the weird magic spreading through the world and need to know what it means.

motivation.label: Free the Oppressed
motivation.answer: They cannot stand seeing people trapped by kings, nobles, debt, monsters, or cruel systems.

motivation.label: Escape Their Past
motivation.answer: They are running from who they were, what they did, or what someone expects them to become.

motivation.label: Find Belonging
motivation.answer: They want to find people who accept them, even if they pretend they do not care.

motivation.label: Preserve History
motivation.answer: They believe old stories, ruins, artifacts, and forgotten truths matter and must not be erased.

motivation.label: Defend Republican Ideals
motivation.answer: They believe monarchies concentrate too much power and are drawn to the ideas represented by Elkenquay.

motivation.label: Defend the Kingdom
motivation.answer: They believe their homeland, crown, or people are worth defending, even if the system is imperfect.

motivation.label: Find Someone Missing
motivation.answer: They are searching for a sibling, parent, lover, mentor, child, or friend who disappeared.

motivation.label: Break a Curse
motivation.answer: They or someone they love is cursed, and adventuring is the only way to find a cure.

motivation.label: Repay a Debt
motivation.answer: Someone saved them, raised them, spared them, or protected them, and now they feel they owe the world something.

motivation.label: Chase Wonder
motivation.answer: They simply want to see impossible places, strange creatures, ancient ruins, and things no one back home would believe.

motivation.label: Become Free
motivation.answer: They were raised under rules, duty, debt, family expectations, or political control, and now they want to choose their own life.

ancestry.label: Human
ancestry.answer: They are adaptable, ambitious, and shaped more by choices than by ancient expectations.

ancestry.label: Dwarf
ancestry.answer: They come from a people tied to stone, craft, endurance, tradition, and deep memory.

ancestry.label: Halfling
ancestry.answer: They are small, brave, underestimated, and possibly much more dangerous than they look.

ancestry.label: Elf
ancestry.answer: They are long-lived and may carry old griefs, ancient knowledge, or a distant view of short-lived people.

ancestry.label: Gnome
ancestry.answer: They are curious, inventive, strange, and probably interested in things others consider dangerous or useless.

ancestry.label: Tiefling
ancestry.answer: They have infernal or demonic traits, but their appearance does not define their morality.

ancestry.label: Orc
ancestry.answer: They are strong and intense, but not automatically cruel, savage, or villainous.

ancestry.label: Tabaxi
ancestry.answer: They are cat-like people who may be curious, quick, graceful, and easily drawn to stories or shiny things.

ancestry.label: Aarakocra / Crowfolk
ancestry.answer: They are bird-like people tied to the sky, omens, travel, freedom, or watchfulness.

ancestry.label: Arryan / Owlfolk
ancestry.answer: They are owl-like people who may seem wise, quiet, eerie, scholarly, or mystical.

ancestry.label: Snake Person
ancestry.answer: They are serpentine and may be mysterious, elegant, ancient, misunderstood, or unsettling.

ancestry.label: Pandarian
ancestry.answer: They are panda-like people who may be gentle, strong, spiritual, humorous, or shockingly dangerous when pushed.

ancestry.label: Polecat
ancestry.answer: They are small mammal-like folk who are quick, perceptive, clever, cute, and adaptable.

ancestry.label: Harpy
ancestry.answer: They are winged people who may be fierce, musical, strange, beautiful, predatory, or tragic.

ancestry.label: Fae / Fae-touched
ancestry.answer: They are connected to faerie magic and may be charming, unsettling, whimsical, oath-bound, or alien in their thinking.

class.label: Fighter
class.answer: They are a trained warrior who solves problems through discipline, skill, and steel.
class.fantasy: I solve problems with skill, discipline, and steel.

class.label: Barbarian
class.answer: They are powered by rage, instinct, endurance, or primal strength.
class.fantasy: When danger comes, I become the danger.

class.label: Rogue
class.answer: They rely on stealth, deception, precision, timing, and cleverness rather than brute force.
class.fantasy: I win by being faster, quieter, and smarter.

class.label: Ranger
class.answer: They are a hunter, tracker, scout, or protector of the borderlands and wild places.
class.fantasy: I know the wild, I know my enemy, and I know how to survive.

class.label: Druid
class.answer: They are connected to animals, plants, storms, spirits, the moon, or the balance of nature.
class.fantasy: The natural world has power, and I speak for it.

class.label: Paladin
class.answer: They are a warrior whose power comes from an oath, conviction, faith, justice, vengeance, or duty.

class.label: Cleric
class.answer: They are connected to a god, philosophy, sacred force, or cosmic domain.
class.fantasy: I am the hand of something greater than myself.

class.label: Wizard
class.answer: They study magic like a science, art, language, or dangerous obsession.
class.fantasy: Reality has rules, and I have learned how to rewrite them.

class.label: Sorcerer
class.answer: Their magic comes from bloodline, destiny, trauma, mutation, or some supernatural event.
class.fantasy: Magic is not something I do. It is something I am.

class.label: Warlock
class.answer: They gained power through a pact with something powerful, strange, divine, infernal, fey, or ancient.
class.fantasy: I made a deal, and now I have power. The cost is the question.

class.label: Bard
class.answer: They use music, stories, words, performance, lore, or charisma to shape the world.
class.fantasy: Stories, songs, and words have power.

class.label: Monk
class.answer: They turn discipline, motion, spirit, and their own body into a weapon.
class.fantasy: My body, mind, and spirit are my weapon.

class.label: Artificer
class.answer: They use invention, craft, tools, magical devices, and strange engineering to solve problems.
class.fantasy: Magic is something I can build.

class.label: Blood Hunter
class.answer: They use dangerous power, sacrifice, curses, or forbidden techniques to hunt monsters.
class.fantasy: I became something frightening to fight something worse.

class.label: Multiclass Concept
class.answer: They blend two ideas, such as a rogue-warlock with a dangerous pact or a fighter-druid who defends nature with steel.
class.fantasy: I am not just one thing.

background.label: Acolyte
background.answer: They were raised in or devoted to a temple, faith, cult, monastery, or religious order.
background.benefits: Usually gives Insight and Religion, two languages, and temple support through Shelter of the Faithful.

background.label: Charlatan
background.answer: They survived through scams, false identities, forged papers, cons, or carefully performed lies.
background.benefits: Usually gives Deception and Sleight of Hand, disguise kit, forgery kit, and a false identity.

background.label: Criminal
background.answer: They have history with crime, gangs, smuggling, burglary, spying, or underground networks.
background.benefits: Usually gives Deception and Stealth, thieves' tools, a gaming set, and a criminal contact.

background.label: Spy
background.answer: They dealt in secrets, surveillance, infiltration, and information gathering.
background.benefits: Usually uses Criminal-style benefits, flavored around intelligence contacts and covert work.

background.label: Entertainer
background.answer: They performed as a musician, actor, dancer, storyteller, juggler, comedian, or public spectacle.
background.benefits: Usually gives Acrobatics and Performance, disguise kit, a musical instrument, and hospitality through By Popular Demand.

background.label: Gladiator
background.answer: They performed through combat, spectacle, bloodsport, or arena fighting.
background.benefits: Usually uses Entertainer-style benefits, flavored around arena reputation and performance fighting.

background.label: Folk Hero
background.answer: They came from ordinary people and became known for standing up to danger, injustice, monsters, nobles, or bullies.
background.benefits: Usually gives Animal Handling and Survival, artisan's tools, land vehicles, and help from common folk through Rustic Hospitality.

background.label: Guild Artisan
background.answer: They trained in a respected craft, trade, or professional guild.
background.benefits: Usually gives Insight and Persuasion, artisan's tools, a language, and guild support through Guild Membership.

background.label: Guild Merchant
background.answer: They came from commerce, negotiation, transport, markets, and business relationships.
background.benefits: Usually uses Guild Artisan-style benefits, flavored toward trade contacts and business credibility.

background.label: Hermit
background.answer: They lived apart from society in isolation, contemplation, exile, study, survival, or spiritual retreat.
background.benefits: Usually gives Medicine and Religion, herbalism kit, a language, and a hidden truth through Discovery.

background.label: Noble
background.answer: They were born into wealth, rank, courtly politics, noble obligations, or a powerful family name.
background.benefits: Usually gives History and Persuasion, a gaming set, a language, and social recognition through Position of Privilege.

background.label: Knight
background.answer: They gained status through martial service, chivalry, oath, land, or sworn duty.
background.benefits: Usually uses Noble-style benefits, flavored around knightly recognition, retainers, or martial honor.

background.label: Outlander
background.answer: They grew up beyond settled civilization as a wanderer, exile, nomad, hunter, guide, or wilderness survivor.
background.benefits: Usually gives Athletics and Survival, a musical instrument, a language, and wilderness survival help through Wanderer.

background.label: Sage
background.answer: They were a scholar, researcher, librarian, apprentice wizard, professor, historian, astronomer, or obsessive student.
background.benefits: Usually gives Arcana and History, two languages, and help finding obscure information through Researcher.

background.label: Sailor
background.answer: They spent years aboard ships, learning the sea, storms, ports, crews, ropes, and shipboard discipline.
background.benefits: Usually gives Athletics and Perception, navigator's tools, water vehicles, and access to sea travel through Ship's Passage.

background.label: Pirate
background.answer: They lived at sea through raiding, smuggling, intimidation, mutiny, or illegal freedom.
background.benefits: Usually uses Sailor-style benefits, often with a feared reputation through Bad Reputation.

background.label: Soldier
background.answer: They served in an army, militia, guard, mercenary company, noble retinue, or organized fighting force.
background.benefits: Usually gives Athletics and Intimidation, a gaming set, land vehicles, and recognition through Military Rank.

background.label: Urchin
background.answer: They grew up poor, alone, abandoned, or street-raised, surviving through speed, awareness, theft, begging, or cleverness.
background.benefits: Usually gives Sleight of Hand and Stealth, disguise kit, thieves' tools, and city movement knowledge through City Secrets.

family_relationship.label: Loving and Stable
family_relationship.answer: They grew up in a loving home and left because they wanted adventure, not because they were trying to escape.

family_relationship.label: Loving but Strict
family_relationship.answer: Their family loved them, but had very clear expectations about duty, career, marriage, faith, or tradition.

family_relationship.label: Distant but Safe
family_relationship.answer: Their family provided for them, but emotional warmth was rare, so they learned independence early.

family_relationship.label: Overprotective
family_relationship.answer: Their family tried to shelter them from danger, which made them desperate to prove they could survive on their own.

family_relationship.label: Large Chaotic Family
family_relationship.answer: They grew up surrounded by siblings, cousins, noise, arguments, food, stories, and very little privacy.

family_relationship.label: Only Child
family_relationship.answer: They were the center of their family's hopes, worries, and expectations, for better or worse.

family_relationship.label: Favored Child
family_relationship.answer: They were treated as special, talented, or destined for something, and now struggle with pressure or guilt.

family_relationship.label: Black Sheep
family_relationship.answer: They never fit what their family wanted them to be, and leaving home felt inevitable.

family_relationship.label: Family Business
family_relationship.answer: They were expected to inherit or continue a family trade, shop, farm, temple role, criminal network, or noble duty.

family_relationship.label: Military Family
family_relationship.answer: Their family valued discipline, service, loyalty, and toughness, whether or not the character agreed with those values.

family_relationship.label: Criminal Family
family_relationship.answer: Their family survived through theft, smuggling, scams, or underground deals, and the character may be proud, ashamed, or conflicted.

family_relationship.label: Adopted or Taken In
family_relationship.answer: They were raised by people who were not their birth family, and that shaped how they think about blood, loyalty, and belonging.

family_relationship.label: Orphaned Young
family_relationship.answer: They lost their family early and were shaped by whoever, or whatever, helped them survive afterward.

family_relationship.label: Raised by the Community
family_relationship.answer: No single person raised them; they belonged to a village, temple, caravan, ship, troupe, or circle.

family_relationship.label: Noble Family
family_relationship.answer: They grew up with status, education, and expectations, but may have seen the cruelty or emptiness behind polite society.

family_relationship.label: Poor but Loving
family_relationship.answer: Their family had very little, but gave them love, humor, survival skills, and a reason to want a better life.

family_relationship.label: Wealthy but Cold
family_relationship.answer: They had comfort and opportunity, but affection was conditional, distant, or treated like a weakness.

family_relationship.label: Secretive Family
family_relationship.answer: Their family hid something important: a crime, a curse, a pact, a forbidden lineage, or the truth about where they came from.

family_relationship.label: Betrayed by Family
family_relationship.answer: Someone in their family used, abandoned, sold out, framed, or sacrificed them, and that wound still shapes them.

family_relationship.label: Family Lost to War
family_relationship.answer: War, politics, conscription, famine, or invasion shattered their family, leaving them with grief and unfinished questions.

left_home.label: Never Really Left
left_home.answer: They still think of home as home, write letters when they can, and expect to return someday.

left_home.label: Left as a Child
left_home.answer: They left home very young due to tragedy, poverty, danger, abandonment, or being taken in by someone else.

left_home.label: Left as a Teenager
left_home.answer: They left as a teenager, either running away, being sent away, apprenticing, joining a group, or chasing independence.

left_home.label: Left at Adulthood
left_home.answer: They left when they came of age because it was expected, celebrated, or necessary in their culture.

left_home.label: Ran Away
left_home.answer: They left suddenly, without permission, and may still feel guilt, fear, or pride about it.

left_home.label: Sent Away
left_home.answer: Their family sent them away for schooling, safety, punishment, apprenticeship, politics, or because they were different.

left_home.label: Banished
left_home.answer: They were forced to leave and are not welcome back unless something major changes.

left_home.label: Left After a Death
left_home.answer: They left after a parent, sibling, mentor, spouse, or friend died, because staying hurt too much.

left_home.label: Left After a Betrayal
left_home.answer: They left when they learned someone close to them had lied, used them, or hidden the truth.

left_home.label: Left for Training
left_home.answer: They left to become a soldier, mage, priest, druid, performer, spy, knight, monk, or apprentice.

left_home.label: Left for Love
left_home.answer: They left home because of love: to follow someone, escape an arranged match, protect someone, or recover from heartbreak.

left_home.label: Left for Money
left_home.answer: They left because their family needed money, or because poverty made staying impossible.

left_home.label: Left to Escape Expectations
left_home.answer: They left because home had already decided who they were supposed to become.

left_home.label: Left to Find the Truth
left_home.answer: They left after discovering a clue, secret, prophecy, map, letter, symbol, or strange magical event.

left_home.label: Left Because of War
left_home.answer: They left because war, conscription, occupation, raids, or political violence made home unsafe.

left_home.label: Left with Their Family's Blessing
left_home.answer: Their family supported their departure, even if it was painful.

left_home.label: Left Without Saying Goodbye
left_home.answer: They disappeared without a proper farewell and may dread the day someone asks why.

left_home.label: Left and Cannot Return
left_home.answer: They would go home if they could, but home is destroyed, occupied, cursed, politically dangerous, or no longer exists.

left_home.label: Left to Prove Themselves
left_home.answer: They left because they were tired of being treated like a child, failure, burden, joke, or disappointment.

left_home.label: Left by Accident
left_home.answer: They did not mean to become an adventurer; one bad day, strange job, wrong road, or weird magical incident changed everything.

complication.label: Gets Attached Too Easily
complication.answer: They try to stay independent, but they keep caring about people they meant to keep at a distance.

complication.label: Haunted by the Past
complication.answer: Something they did, failed to do, or survived still follows them.

complication.label: Dangerous Secret
complication.answer: They are hiding something that could change how the party sees them.

complication.label: Family Expectations
complication.answer: Their family already decided who they were supposed to become, and they are trying to escape or live up to it.

complication.label: Owes a Debt
complication.answer: They owe money, loyalty, a favor, a life debt, or a promise to someone dangerous or important.

complication.label: Wanted
complication.answer: Someone is looking for them: the law, a noble, a guild, a criminal group, a cult, or their own family.

complication.label: Does Not Trust People
complication.answer: They want connection, but experience has taught them that trust is dangerous.

complication.label: Too Much Pride
complication.answer: They struggle to admit weakness, ask for help, or back down when they should.

complication.label: Afraid of Their Own Power
complication.answer: They have abilities, anger, magic, or instincts they do not fully trust.

complication.label: Tempted by Power
complication.answer: They want to do the right thing, but power, recognition, revenge, or control keeps tempting them.

complication.label: Divided Loyalties
complication.answer: They care about two people, nations, causes, gods, or ideals that may come into conflict.

complication.label: Bad Reputation
complication.answer: People have heard stories about them, and some of those stories are true.

complication.label: Naive
complication.answer: They are capable and sincere, but they do not yet understand how cruel, political, or complicated the world can be.

complication.label: Reckless
complication.answer: They act before thinking when emotions run high, especially if someone is in danger.

complication.label: Protective to a Fault
complication.answer: They will put themselves in danger for others, even when nobody asked them to.

complication.label: Cannot Go Home
complication.answer: They would return home if they could, but home is destroyed, unsafe, cursed, occupied, or no longer wants them.

complication.label: Hunted by a Pact or Promise
complication.answer: They made a bargain, oath, promise, or mistake that now demands payment.

complication.label: Secretly Guilty
complication.answer: They blame themselves for something, whether or not it was actually their fault.

complication.label: Does Not Belong
complication.answer: They feel out of place wherever they go: too strange for home, too shaped by home for the wider world.

complication.label: The Truth Would Hurt
complication.answer: They are searching for answers, but part of them is afraid of what the truth will cost.

downtime.label: Terrible Liar
downtime.answer: They are brave in battle but completely unable to lie convincingly during games like Two Truths and a Lie.

downtime.label: Too Good at Lying
downtime.answer: They lie so smoothly that the party starts wondering how much of their backstory is true.

downtime.label: Secret Romantic
downtime.answer: They act tough or detached but secretly love poetry, songs, love stories, or dramatic confessions.

downtime.label: Embarrassing Past
downtime.answer: They once did something deeply embarrassing and will do almost anything to keep the party from learning about it.

downtime.label: Hidden Crime
downtime.answer: They committed a crime in the past, but the story is more complicated than it first sounds.

downtime.label: Unexpected Hobby
downtime.answer: They have a hobby no one expects, like knitting, birdwatching, baking, calligraphy, dancing, or collecting spoons.

downtime.label: Obvious Soft Spot
downtime.answer: They become completely different around children, animals, old people, or anyone who reminds them of home.

downtime.label: Campfire Storyteller
downtime.answer: They always have a story to tell, but no one is sure whether the stories are true, exaggerated, or stolen.

downtime.label: Unexpected Serious Topic
downtime.answer: They joke constantly until one specific subject comes up, and then they become quiet and intense.

downtime.label: Strange Superstition
downtime.answer: They follow a weird personal rule or superstition that may or may not have any real magical basis.

downtime.label: Secretly Kind
downtime.answer: They pretend to be selfish, but quietly leave food, coins, or protection for people who need help.

downtime.label: Keeps Trophies
downtime.answer: They collect little objects from places they have been, each with a story attached.

downtime.label: Over-Sharer
downtime.answer: They answer simple questions with wildly personal stories that make everyone uncomfortable.

downtime.label: Never Answers Directly
downtime.answer: They dodge personal questions with jokes, riddles, insults, or by asking someone else a question.

downtime.label: Three Truths Problem
downtime.answer: During Two Truths and a Lie, they accidentally give three true statements because their life is already ridiculous.

downtime.label: Secretly Afraid
downtime.answer: They seem confident, but a very ordinary thing scares them more than monsters do.

downtime.label: Odd Collection
downtime.answer: They collect something strange, useless, sentimental, or mildly concerning.

downtime.label: Writes Letters
downtime.answer: They write letters to someone regularly, even if they never send them.

downtime.label: Talks in Their Sleep
downtime.answer: They occasionally say names, warnings, jokes, or secrets while asleep.

downtime.label: Camp Cook
downtime.answer: They take cooking very seriously and judge people by how they treat a shared meal.
